sample_scope: One finite ABBA; each arm has 60 aggregate operation calls and 12 launch/12 live-cancel calls. C6 descriptive comparison, not a saturation or significance claim.
throughput_scope: Successful native RPC count divided by sum of per-phase complete RPC spans; prepare, independent SSH inspection, crash and observation-only phases excluded.
cpu_gate_scope: Controller utime+stime from complete phase brackets. B total must not exceed A total plus one raw clock tick per included phase/round. This is a declared resolution tolerance, not a performance improvement claim.
rss_scope: Largest sampled controller RSS across all three controller generations of both rounds per arm; must meet both absolute and ratio gates.
adoption_requires: normal lifecycle correctness and performance gates
